size.about: A number written alone in a component block is a size, and a size is more than zero. A number in a tuple is a position and may have any sign. Measured on 2026-11-09: all 718 sizes in the 102 designs of the repository that lower are positive.

input.about: The least value a signed bound of each dimension may take. A dimension that is not listed may have any sign: a force has a direction. A temperature is in degrees Celsius, so its floor is absolute zero.
